landingPage.headline: Your logistics stack stops at the portal. Emil keeps going.
landingPage.subheadline: Your TMS holds the shipment. Then someone opens Portbase, or DMS, or NCTS, or a carrier eBooking screen, and keys it in again by hand. There is no API waiting on the other side, and there never will be for most of them. Emil carries approved shipment data from your TMS into those portals. It rehearses the entire run first against a copy of your real environment, shows your declarant exactly what it is about to enter, and does nothing until they approve it.
landingPage.description: Emil handles customs and carrier portal operations by rehearsing approved shipment entry against a copy of the real environment before a declarant approves anything.

capabilities.title: WHO THIS IS FOR
capabilities.body: Customs brokers and freight forwarders, 10 to 150 people. In-house trade compliance teams. The declarations are real. The volumes are rising. Hiring another declarant is not happening this year. ICS2 Release 3 has been mandatory across all Member States since September 2025, and the last derogations expired in June 2026. NCTS Phase 6 landed alongside it. The filing load that arrived with them is not going back down, and no one is coming to take it away.

roiCalculator.heading: What could DMS rehearsal return to your desk?
roiCalculator.subheading: Model one Dutch DMS 4.0 import workflow. Emil prepares and checks a review-ready packet; your authorised declarant still reviews and submits.
roiCalculator.disclaimer: Customer-provided and modeled estimates, not observed results or guaranteed savings. Emil does not submit, act as a declarant or customs broker, hold EORI or eHerkenning credentials, or guarantee DMS acceptance or compliance.

currencyCopy.loading: Checking the local currency. Amounts remain in {currency} until a rate is available.
currencyCopy.unavailable: A current local exchange rate is unavailable. Amounts remain in {currency}.
currencyCopy.converted: Amounts converted from {base} to {currency} using the reference rate dated {date}.
currencyCopy.basis: Currency conversion is not local cost research. Enter your own local costs and contribution assumptions. Language changes do not change amounts.

costCopy.breakdown: How your Emil price is built
costCopy.budgetOnly: This is your total budget. Switch to Cost breakdown to itemize it; no split has been assumed.
costCopy.benefitNotice: Modeled benefits, not charges. Crossed-out amounts are spending you expect to avoid, not discounts on the AI bill.
costCopy.allocation: Returned hours are capacity, not automatic payroll savings. Add a monetary value only when it is supported by your own operating data.

copy.workloadIntro: Enter one customer workflow. Emil prepares a review-ready packet; the authorised declarant still reviews and submits.
copy.costIntro: Customer pricing is based on the workflow and review-ready declaration volume. Tokens remain an internal delivery-cost input.
copy.valueIntro: Add customer evidence for correction work and specialist capacity. Incomplete correction data is not treated as zero.
copy.sampleNotice: Customer inputs required · no benchmark assumed
copy.retained: Capacity not allocated to paid-cost reduction
copy.reviewNote: Existing-team review uses returned capacity. Additional paid review is included in operating cost, not deducted again from team capacity.
copy.budgetNote: The budget must include models/media, tools, infrastructure, Gabriel fees and additional paid review. Do not include unchanged payroll as new spending.
copy.itemizedNote: Token usage is calculated from volume × tokens per output. Extra media, tools and infrastructure stay at zero unless they apply. Additional paid review is calculated from review hours and its rate.
copy.paybackOutsideTerm: Not recovered within the modeled term
copy.annualNote: The same monthly assumptions, without growth or compounding. Hiring savings last only for the entered period.
copy.methodBody: Preparation capacity equals eligible declarations × current preparation minutes × Emil’s assisted share, minus human review. Complete correction inputs add the difference between current and Emil-assisted rework. Monetary benefit uses only the supported specialist value and any distinct paid cost that actually stops.
copy.formulaLabel: Benefit-cost multiple equals customer benefit divided by Emil price. ROI equals benefit minus price, divided by price. First-year cost includes the setup fee once.
copy.allocationNote: Each hour can be allocated once. Unallocated hours remain capacity, with no monetary value.
copy.overlapLabel: The paid cost avoided is separate from the capacity value and is not counted elsewhere.
copy.overlapNote: Error and risk estimates exclude labor savings and the same incident must not appear in both categories. Contribution excludes AI costs, which are deducted separately.
copy.hiringLabel: This hire was genuinely planned and the allocated capacity can cover the work.
copy.reviewedLabel: I have reviewed the paid-cost assumptions and excluded amounts already counted as capacity value.
copy.throughputResult: Additional work supported by capacity and demand
copy.assumptionsIncomplete: Enter the required customer workload and specialist-value assumptions to calculate ROI.
copy.allocationError: Allocated hours exceed the net capacity available. Reduce the allocations.
copy.reviewError: Review takes more time than the work reduced. No positive capacity is available at these assumptions.
copy.cashError: Avoided spending cannot exceed current spending or have positive value with no hours allocated.
copy.hiringError: Allocated capacity must cover the planned hire hours. Confirm the planned hire and its duration.
copy.riskError: The after probability cannot exceed the before probability for a loss-reduction estimate.
copy.overlapError: Confirm the benefits do not overlap before including them in the financial result.
copy.boundsError: Use values within the displayed limits.
copy.noCurrencyChange: Language changes formatting, not your currency or assumptions.

volume.label: Eligible DMS import declarations per month
volume.help: Count declarations in the selected H1 import workflow that Emil could rehearse. Do not include other portals or customs processes.

accepted_rate.label: Expected acceptance rate
accepted_rate.help: Optional modeled share of prepared outputs accepted by the recipient. This is not a guarantee or observed result.

attendance_rate.label: Expected attendance rate
attendance_rate.help: Modeled share of accepted meetings expected to happen. Replace this with verified event records after a pilot.

minutes.label: Current preparation minutes per declaration
minutes.help: Use a time study for hands-on preparation before review, correction or live submission.

automation.label: Share of preparation minutes Emil performs
automation.help: Enter a customer assumption or observed pilot result. This is a share of preparation time, not a submission or acceptance rate.

review.label: Human review minutes per rehearsed declaration
review.help: Time the authorised declarant needs to inspect Emil’s packet before submitting through existing customs software.

correction_rate_before.label: Current DMS correction rate
correction_rate_before.help: Share of eligible declarations that currently require a correction or rework cycle. Leave blank until measured.

correction_rate_after.label: Correction rate with Emil
correction_rate_after.help: Observed or explicitly modeled share requiring correction after Emil. Leave blank until supported.

correction_minutes_before.label: Current minutes per correction
correction_minutes_before.help: Hands-on specialist time for one current correction cycle.

correction_minutes_after.label: Minutes per correction with Emil
correction_minutes_after.help: Hands-on time to resolve an Emil exception, abstention or later correction.

cycles_per_unit.label: Cycles per unit each month
cycles_per_unit.help: How many recurring order, review or processing cycles each unit runs in a typical month.

tokens_per_output.label: Tokens to produce one unit
tokens_per_output.help: Modeled tokens consumed to prepare one typical output, not a provider meter reading.

budget.label: Estimated monthly operating budget
budget.help: Include token usage, models/media, tools, infrastructure, Gabriel fees and additional paid review.

model_cost.label: Extra models and media
model_cost.help: Only image, video or other generation charged separately from token usage. Enter zero if none.

tools_cost.label: Tools and integrations
tools_cost.help: Browser sessions, connectors and other metered services. Enter zero if none.

infrastructure_cost.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure_cost.help: Incremental hosting, storage and compute for this workload. Enter zero if none.

platform_cost.label: Other delivery and support cost
platform_cost.help: Modeled hosting, storage, monitoring and support cost, separate from the customer price.

customer_price.label: Monthly base subscription
customer_price.help: Proposed price for one desk and one DMS import workflow, excluding VAT.

personal_value_per_hour.label: Optional value you assign to an hour
personal_value_per_hour.help: An optional personal comparison only. This is not salary, wages or guaranteed cash savings.

capacity_value_per_hour.label: Fully loaded specialist value per hour
capacity_value_per_hour.help: Use a customer-supported operating value. It measures capacity, not automatic payroll savings.

included_volume.label: Declarations included each month
included_volume.help: Review-ready declarations included in the monthly base subscription.

overage_price.label: Price per additional declaration
overage_price.help: Applied only to eligible declarations above the included monthly volume.

setup_fee.label: One-time workflow mapping
setup_fee.help: Mapping and onboarding cost counted once in the first-year comparison.

contract_months.label: Contract comparison period
contract_months.help: Used to show whether the one-time setup fee is recovered within the modeled term.

review_rate.label: Additional paid review per hour
review_rate.help: Actual extra reviewer spending, not the salary of an unchanged employee.

cash_hours.label: Hours tied to paid work that stops
cash_hours.help: Use only hours linked to evidenced overtime, contractor or external-review spending.

cash_baseline.label: Current monthly paid cost
cash_baseline.help: Current overtime, contractor or external-review spend for this workflow.

cash_avoided.label: Monthly paid cost actually avoided
cash_avoided.help: Amount that would stop under the modeled workflow. Exclude capacity value already counted above.

higher_value_hours.label: Hours used for higher-value work
higher_value_hours.help: Hours you can realistically redirect, not the entire capacity by default.

contribution_rate.label: Incremental contribution per hour
contribution_rate.help: Revenue less incremental delivery costs, excluding AI costs counted separately. Not salary or gross revenue.

throughput_hours.label: Hours used for additional volume
throughput_hours.help: This allocation cannot also be used for advisory work or spending reductions.

extra_minutes.label: Team minutes per additional unit
extra_minutes.help: The remaining human effort, including review, needed to deliver one more unit.

demand.label: Additional units with expected demand
demand.help: Capacity alone is not demand. Enter the extra monthly work you expect to take on.

unit_margin.label: Contribution per additional unit
unit_margin.help: Incremental revenue less delivery costs; AI operating costs are deducted separately.

hiring_hours.label: Hours covering the planned hire
hiring_hours.help: Allocate capacity to specific planned work, not a generic full-time-equivalent estimate.

planned_hours.label: Monthly hours the planned hire would cover
planned_hours.help: The allocated capacity must cover this entire workload.

hire_cost.label: Monthly hire cost actually deferred
hire_cost.help: Use the cost of a genuinely planned hire, not the salary of someone already employed.

hire_months.label: Months that hire is deferred
hire_months.help: One to twelve months; the annual estimate stops counting savings after this period.

incidents.label: Expected avoided errors per month
incidents.help: Use your baseline and expected reduction. Exclude incidents also counted as risk reduction.

incident_cost.label: Incremental cost per error
incident_cost.help: Exclude labor, refunds or other losses already included elsewhere.

probability_before.label: Monthly loss probability before
probability_before.help: Your estimate, not a guaranteed risk assessment.

probability_after.label: Monthly loss probability after
probability_after.help: Use the same event and monthly time horizon as the baseline.

loss.label: Loss exposure for that event
loss.help: Exclude error incidents and spending already counted. This is uncertain expected value, not cash saved.

days_before.label: Cycle time before, in days
days_before.help: Elapsed time from start to completion, separate from hands-on effort.

days_after.label: Cycle time after, in days
days_after.help: Shown as an operational change only, without an assumed monetary value.

outcomes.label: Add evidenced paid cost avoided
outcomes.help: Optional: include overtime, contractor or external-review spending that will actually stop. Do not count the same hours again as capacity value.

pricing.label: Your Emil price
pricing.help: Proposed production offer: €950 per month ex VAT for one DMS import workflow and desk, including 400 review-ready declarations, then €2 each, plus a €3,000 one-time mapping fee. Tokens set Emil’s delivery-cost floor; customers pay for the governed workflow and review-ready volume.
